query: James Spedding was chiefly known as the editor of the works of an author who served both as Attorney General and as what?

pipeline_result.response: James Spedding was primarily known as the editor of the works of an author who served both as Attorney General and as a member of the House of Representatives. He played a significant role in shaping the legislative agenda during his tenure, which spanned from 1867 to 1893.
